newsitem.title: USA: Uruguay buys one mln bbls of Suez Blend for March.
newsitem.headline: Uruguay buys one mln bbls of Suez Blend for March.

text.p: Uruguay's state-owned oil refiner ANCAP bought one million barrels of Suez Blend crude for late-March delivery in its latest purchase tender, trade sources said on Thursday.
The price was related to dated Brent, the sources said.
ANCAP awarded the tender to Brazil's state-owned oil company Petrobras, which will act as a trader in this transaction, they said.
The crude will be delivered to Uruguay's Jose Ignacio terminal.
Egyptian Suez Blend, also known as Gulf of Suez, is a sour crude with an API gravity of 31.5 degrees.
ANCAP originally sought delivery for April 5-10, but the timing was adjusted to suit the transaction, the sources said.

Meanwhile, traders said Uruguay's 34,600 barrels per day (bpd) La Teja refinery, currently out of operation to replace its catalytic cracker, will come back on line in April instead of later this month as was anticipated earlier.
